units: Targ. Jud. VIII, 6 s. v. גְּרַד; cmp. סָרַק) place of torture and execution, (Roman) executioner’s scaffold, gallows.
<cite ref="Shabbat 32a:6">Sabb. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>העולה לג׳ לידון</he> he who ascends the scaffold to be punished.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:7">Ab. Zar. I, 7</cite> <he>בסילקי ג׳ וכ׳</he> a basilica, a scaffold &c., interpreted <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 16b:14">ib. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>בס׳ של ג׳</he> a basilica for tortures, executions &c., i.e. a basilica for holding court. Pesik. Shimu, p. 118ᵇ <he>תלאו בגרדון</he> ordered him to be suspended on the gallows (for torture); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:17">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> top <he>תְּלָיָין בג׳</he> (cmp.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 10">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. X</cite>, end <he>והגרדין טהור</he> ed. Zuck. (ed. <cite ref="B01180"><he>ברדין</he></cite>; corr. acc.) the torturer’s block is not affected by levitical impurity.
